_comment: Example JSON instructions file for the JSON-Driven SAM3 Video Pipeline.
_comment2: Every event needs either 'timestamp_s' (seconds) OR 'frame_idx' (frame number).
_comment3: Events are processed in order. SAM3 segments based on 'segment_target' events.

events._comment2: Tell SAM3 what to look for and track. Use this at any point in the video.
Tile an image from overlay_images/ folder over a segmented mask.
events._comment3: image_name: filename in overlay_images/ (with or without extension).
events._comment4: subject: what SAM3 labeled the mask (must match a segment_target above).
events._comment6: invert: true = apply image to EVERYTHING EXCEPT the mask. Default: false.
events.subject: wall

events._comment2: Apply a standard SAM3 effect to a segmented mask.
events._comment3: effect values: blur, dim, highlight, color, grayscale, pixelate, frosted_glass, redact, outline
events._comment5: invert: apply to everything EXCEPT the mask.
events._comment6: color_hex: only used when effect is 'color'.
events.subject: person

events.subject: person

events._comment: Example: color tint on a specific object
events.subject: wall

events._comment2: Trigger the conversation mode AR animation.
events._comment3: Finds the nearest/largest detected person, keeps them in full color.
events._comment4: Everything else gets a grayscale+blur that sweeps in from the edges.
events._comment5: animation_duration_s: how long the sweep-in animation takes (default 1.5s).
events._comment6: blur_intensity: 0.0–1.0, how strong the background blur is (default 1.0).
events._comment7: subject: usually 'person' — SAM3 must have segmented a person already.
events._comment8: end_timestamp_s: when to stop the effect (omit to hold until end of video).
events.subject: person

events._comment2b: tracking the new object from this frame onward.

events._comment: Overlay an image on a laptop starting at 52 seconds
events.subject: laptop

segment_target.description: Tell SAM3 what objects to detect and segment.
segment_target.targets: Array of strings — SAM3 text prompts e.g. ['wall', 'person', 'laptop']

overlay_image.description: Tile an image from overlay_images/ folder over the segmented mask.

optional_fields.invert: true = apply to background instead of subject (default false)
optional_fields.end_timestamp_s: When to stop (omit = hold for rest of video)
optional_fields.end_frame_idx: Alternative: stop at specific frame number

effect.description: Apply a standard visual effect to a segmented mask.

conversation_mode.description: Inverted mask animation: nearest person stays in full color, surroundings fade to grayscale+blur with a cinematic sweep-in.
conversation_mode.subject: Usually 'person' — must match a segment already tracked by SAM3

timing_fields.timestamp_s: Time in seconds (float). Use this OR frame_idx.
timing_fields.frame_idx: Frame number (integer). Use this OR timestamp_s.
timing_fields.end_timestamp_s: End time in seconds. If omitted, effect runs until end of video.
timing_fields.end_frame_idx: End frame number. Alternative to end_timestamp_s.
